answer_value: Unfolded: left half dot-corner, right arrow, down/up arrows with circle toward centre; right half mirrored with left arrows
steps: Paper folded right half onto left, then top half down; cuts are in the bottom-left quarter: up-arrow with circle to its right (toward vertical fold), right-arrow below, dot at outer bottom-left corner.
Unfold horizontal fold: top-left quarter is vertical reflection: dot top-left corner, right arrow, down-arrow with circle to its right.
Unfold vertical fold: right half is horizontal mirror: left arrows, circles on the centre side of the vertical arrows, dots at right corners.
A: top row arrows point outward (left arrow on left side) - fails. B: circles on outer side of down-arrows in top half - fails. C: both top arrows point left - fails.
D: dots at 4 corners, right/left arrows facing centre, circles between vertical arrows - matches.

answer_value: Top row h,v,h; middle row: vertical at left and horizontal at centre
steps: Segments are added one per figure in a 3x3 grid reading order, alternating horizontal/vertical: TL(h), TM(v), TR(h), ML(v), next MC(h).
A: middle-left is horizontal and no MC segment - fails. B: extra segment at middle-right - fails. C: vertical at middle-right - fails.
D: top row h,v,h plus vertical at ML and horizontal at MC - matches.

answer_value: Central diamond with two pairs of close ovals near top and bottom centre
steps: Folded right-to-left then top-down; final piece is bottom-left quarter with folds at its right and top edges.
Diagonal cut across the corner where both folds meet (paper centre) -> a diamond hole in the centre.
Oval near bottom, about two-thirds across the quarter toward the vertical fold -> 4 ovals near top/bottom edges close to the vertical centre line.
B: square centre instead of diamond - fails. C: two triangles and corner ovals - fails. D: ovals at far corners - fails.
A: diamond with ovals clustered near centre line at top and bottom - matches.

answer_value: Box corner with diagonal and circle-stem, single horizontal line at bottom
steps: The figure is symmetric across both centre lines: each outer corner region carries one line parallel to its outer edge (top-left, top-right top lines; bottom-left bottom line).
The centre X has only three arms drawn; the missing down-right arm must be in the missing quarter, inside the small box corner.
Circle-stem from the inner box to the outer corner appears in each quarter, so bottom-right has it too.
A and C: extra vertical line along right side - fail. D: no diagonal in the box corner - fails.
B: diagonal in box, circle-stem, single bottom line - matches.

answer_value: Pentagon inverted (point down) with downward-pointing triangle inside
steps: Fig(ii) is fig(i) flipped vertically (house-pentagon becomes point-down).
Flipping fig(iii) vertically gives point-down pentagon containing a point-down triangle.
A: no inner triangle - fails. B: pentagon not flipped - fails. D: nothing flipped - fails.
C matches.
